a = list(map(int, input().split()))
l = [0] * n
r = [0] * n
l[0] = 1
r[n - 1] = 1
for i in range(1, n):
    l[i] = min(l[i - 1] + 1, a[i])
for i in range(n - 2, -1, -1):
    r[i] = min(r[i + 1] + 1, a[i])
